capabilities.capability: Episode Shuffle - Random episode selection across all surfaces (Home, Detail, Playback)
capabilities.source_behavior: Source implements a comprehensive episode shuffle system: EpisodeShuffle class manages per-surface (DETAIL/HOME/PLAYBACK) random episode selection with synchronized picker state. RandomEpisodePicker provides weighted random selection (watched vs unwatched). EpisodeShuffleStore persists shuffle profiles per-user. EpisodeShufflePlayback integrates shuffle into player auto-next. Detail screen has ShuffleButton, EpisodeShuffleDialog for configuration (includeWatched toggle), EpisodeShufflePreview for episode preview. Home screen applies shuffle to ContinueWatching/NextUp items. EpisodeShuffleBadge decorates shuffle-enabled items.
capabilities.target_behavior: NO equivalent found in target. Target has no EpisodeShuffle, RandomEpisodePicker, ShuffleSurface, ShuffleButton, EpisodeShuffleDialog, EpisodeShufflePreview, EpisodeShuffleBadge, EpisodeShufflePlayback, or EpisodeShuffleStore classes. Target's SeriesPlaybackResolver handles standard sequential episode progression only.
gaps: Complete episode shuffle system missing: no shuffle state management, no per-surface random episode selection, no shuffle dialog/preview UI, no shuffle badge, no shuffle auto-next integration
No EpisodeShuffleStore for persisting shuffle profiles
capabilities.ios_implementation_plan: Port EpisodeShuffle class, RandomEpisodePicker, ShuffleSurface enum. Create EpisodeShuffleStore using platform storage. Add ShuffleButton composable to detail screen hero area. Create EpisodeShuffleDialog modal with includeWatched toggle and episode preview. Wire shuffle selection into SeriesPlaybackResolver for auto-next. Add HomeEpisodeShuffle integration into HomeContinueWatchingSection. Add EpisodeShuffleBadge to poster cards.
tests: EpisodeShuffle unit tests (picker logic, weighted selection, watched/unwatched filtering)
platform_limitations: Touch-native: shuffle dialog/overlay adapted from TV dialog to bottom sheet or modal

capabilities.capability: Custom Poster URL resolution with templates, scope, and fallback
capabilities.source_behavior: CustomPosterUrlResolver resolves poster URLs using templates with {imdb_id}/{tmdb_id}/{tvdb_id} placeholders from services like ratingposterdb.com, aioratings.com, top-posters.com. Supports multiple ID types and fallback chains (imdb→tmdb→tvdb). CustomPosterScreen enum defines per-screen scope (HOME, DETAIL, CONTINUE_WATCHING, COLLECTIONS, LIBRARY, SEARCH) with toKeys/fromKeys serialization. CustomPosterOverlay provides extension functions on Meta, MetaPreview, LibraryEntry, ContinueWatchingItem, TmdbEntityBrowseData for seamless custom poster URL injection. CustomPosterScreenFilter enables per-screen enable/disable. CustomPosterFallbackInterceptor (OkHttp interceptor) provides Coil image loading fallback when custom URL fails.
capabilities.target_behavior: Target has PosterCustomizationSettingsPage.kt that provides poster card style/radius/labels settings, but NO custom poster URL resolution system. No equivalent of CustomPosterUrlResolver (template-based URL resolution with ID substitution), CustomPosterOverlay (extension functions), CustomPosterScreen (per-screen scope), CustomPosterScreenFilter, or CustomPosterFallbackInterceptor (Coil/network fallback). Target's poster customization is limited to card style (PosterCardStyleRepository), corner radius, and label visibility.
gaps: No template-based custom poster URL resolution with {imdb_id}/{tmdb_id}/{tvdb_id} placeholders
No integration with ratingposterdb.com, aioratings.com, top-posters.com or similar services
No per-screen poster scope configuration (CustomPosterScreen enum)
No extension functions for injecting custom poster URLs into Meta/MetaPreview/LibraryEntry/ContinueWatchingItem
No network-level fallback interceptor for failed custom poster loads
capabilities.ios_implementation_plan: Port CustomPosterUrlResolver with template-based URL resolution. Implement per-screen scope enum. Create extension functions on target's Meta/MetaPreview/LibraryEntry models. Add network-level fallback using platform image loading. Build PosterCustomizationSettingsPage UI for pattern configuration and screen scope toggles.
tests: CustomPosterUrlResolverTest (template resolution, ID extraction, fallback chain)
platform_limitations: Touch-native: settings UI adapted from TV overlay to settings page form

capabilities.capability: Home screen layout modes (Modern, Classic, Grid) with selection
capabilities.source_behavior: Source has three home layout modes: MODERN (full-screen backdrop hero with landscape posters, parallax rows, crossfade transitions, focused backdrop trailer playback), CLASSIC (traditional top-focused navigation with row-based content), GRID (dense grid layout). HomeLayout enum defines the three modes. LayoutSelectionScreen and ExperienceModeSelectionScreen allow user to pick layout/experience. Modern layout includes ModernHomeHero (full-screen backdrop with metadata overlay), ModernHomeRows/ModernHomeRowsList (horizontal scrolling rows with parallax), AlwaysCrossfadeTransitionFactory (smooth row transitions). Classic layout uses ClassicHomeContent with ClassicFocusGradientBackdrop. Grid layout uses GridHomeContent.
capabilities.target_behavior: Target has a single HomeScreen with one layout approach. No HomeLayout enum, no layout selection screen, no experience mode selection. Target's HomeHeroSection provides a hero area but without the full-screen backdrop/parallax/crossfade sophistication of Modern mode. Target has no ClassicHomeContent or GridHomeContent equivalents. Target's home screen is a unified scrollable layout with catalog sections, continue watching section, and hero.
gaps: No Modern home layout with full-screen backdrop hero, landscape posters, parallax rows
No Classic home layout with top-focused navigation
No crossfade transition factory for row animations
No focused backdrop trailer playback on hero
capabilities.ios_implementation_plan: Evaluate whether multiple home layouts are needed for mobile (likely single layout is acceptable). If porting: implement HomeLayout enum, add layout persistence to HomeCatalogSettingsRepository, build single HomeScreen that can render all three modes, adapt ModernHomeHero for touch (swipeable hero with parallax).
platform_limitations: TV's three-layout model may be overkill for mobile; single responsive layout with hero may suffice
Parallax/crossfade/backdrop trailer are TV-focused visual effects that may not translate to mobile
Touch-native: no D-pad navigation, swipe gestures replace focus-based row traversal
